summary: Frontend-only test of new PRO tool 'Food Cost & Energia' (Maestro Step 5). Logged in as admin@mikilab.de (PRO), navigated nav-tab-maestro -> maestro-step-5 -> maestro-tool-foodcost. Verified default calculation, reactivity, focus retention while typing multi-digit values, negative-margin warning color, and add-row buttons. All 4 requested scenarios PASSED with zero console errors.

issues: Floating FABs 'Radio' and 'Parla' overlay the green result card while scrolling, partially covering the 'Materie prime'/'Energia' rows and the Margine line; content is readable only after further scrolling. Consider lowering FAB opacity or extra bottom offset for the result panel.

critical_code_review_comments: FoodCost.jsx: ingredient/energy row delete buttons (Trash2) have no data-testid; add fc-del-ingr-{id} / fc-del-energy-{id} for testability.
FoodCost.jsx: no minimum/validation on inputs; negative kg/kW or negative loss% are accepted (loss=150 would give negative baked weight). Consider min=0 clamping.
New ingredient/energy rows use id: Date.now() — adding two rows within the same millisecond would collide (unlikely but use crypto.randomUUID()).
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage key mikilab_foodcost written by the tool itself (values left at pieces=2, dough=1500, sell=3 plus 2 empty rows after test run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Food Cost verified: defaults ingr 3.40 + energy 5.04 (14.4 kWh) = total 8.44, cost/piece 2.11, margin 86%, baked 450 g. pieces=2 -> 4.22 (margin 72%), sell=3 -> margin -41% with warning color text-[#FFD7CF]. Typing '123' into fc-sell and '1500' into fc-dough kept focus (activeElement stayed on input). fc-add-ingr/fc-add-energy added rows (15 -> 19 number inputs) without crash. NOTE: the tool persists state in localStorage, so a fresh browser profile is required to re-verify defaults.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found in the tested feature.
